contribution.position: I hold my earlier position and respond directly to product's claim that 'on reliability, nobody else sees a problem, so I would treat it as settled': that claim is contradicted by artifact:incident-log, which documents a 30-day error rate of 3.2% against a 1% SLO and two sev2 incidents in the same window — a live reliability problem, not a settled one. Absence of objections from cost, ops, and qa is not evidence on this axis, since none of their anchors (artifact:cost-sheet, artifact:ops-runbook, artifact:test-report) measure production error behavior. I also note the round offers no new datum since my last position: artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and artifact:perf-report (p99 within budget) describe pre-production conditions and were already weighed; neither speaks to whether the 3.2% production error rate has recovered to SLO. No recovery or error-budget-replenishment artifact exists in the list to support shipping under an already-breached SLO. Changing the proxy while it is outside its error budget adds regression surface with no demonstrated stable baseline, so the reliability axis continues to oppose.
